payload.text: Welcome to Apollo | Apollo Chemical Skip to main content Welcome to Apollo Being one of the industry's leading innovators isn't just good for us, it's good for our customers. We've carefully established an infrastructure which has enabled our Quality Management System to become ISO 9001:2015 certified. While this certification is a very satisfying achievement for us, it further enhances our value to our customers by assuring our continued adherence to strict quality guidelines, and affirming that Apollo remains committed to the highest industry standards. Since 1998, Apollo Chemical's Quality Management System has been certified as being in conformity with the ISO 9001 standard by Intertek. It is our continued commitment to meeting and exceeding our customer's expectations.
